_comment: The SIS concept manifest: one row per thing that was built more than once.
Why this exists. Between 2026-06-23 and 2026-09-10 the SIS console was built in
eleven one-day rounds, each answering that week's client feedback, and each round
added a feature next to the one that already did most of the job. The audit
(docs/icreate/FRANKENSTEIN_AUDIT_2026-09-17.md) counted the result: seven Stripe
checkout sites, seventeen writers of one settings blob, twenty-seven copies of one
org helper. Between the audit's first sweep and its re-check three days later,
seventeen new duplicates appeared. The plan (docs/sis/CONSOLIDATION_PLAN.md) merges
them one move at a time; this file is what stops them growing in the meantime.
How it is read. backend/tests/unit/test_sis_concepts.py, web/src/__tests__/
sisConcepts.test.js and mobile/src/__tests__/sisConcepts.test.ts each take the rows
that name their side, apply `forbid.<side>.pattern` line by line to the files under
`dirs`, and assert the count is at most `baseline.<side>` (ceiling) and, while the
baseline is above zero, at least one (floor: a scan that stops matching passes
forever). The failing message prints every path:line and `use_instead`, which is the
sentence a session needs at the moment it is about to write another copy.
Fields. `means` says what the concept is. `owner.<side>` lists the canonical files;
they must exist unless the row says `proposed: true`, in which case the move named in
`lowered_by` creates them, and the test fails once they all exist and the flag is
still here. `forbid.<side>` has `pattern` (a regular expression that both Python's re
and JavaScript's RegExp accept: no lookbehind, no inline flags), `dirs` (scan roots
relative to the side's root -- backend/, web/src, mobile/ -- a file path is allowed),
optional `files` (paths whose mere existence counts one each), optional `unit`
('lines', the default, or 'files' when the copies are whole files rather than lines),
and optional `exempt` (paths excluded from the count; defaults to the owners, so a
row whose canonical copy matches its own pattern sets `exempt: []` and a baseline of
one). Test files and __pycache__ are never scanned. `baseline.<side>` is the count
on `measured`; it moves down in the same commit as the merge, never up.
Adding a row is how a concept is declared. If you are about to build something that
has a noun here -- invoice, hold, feed, training, schedule, contact, settings --
extend the owner. If it has no row, add one naming the owner in the same PR.

concepts.means: A row in sis_invoices. Every charge a family sees, whatever created it. Three copies of the insert had drifted on which columns they set; sis_billing_service.write_invoice is the one insert (M6, 2026-09-17), and the manual charge, the tuition approver, the class-registration cart, the recurring biller and the event RSVP fee reach it through create_charge / create_tuition_invoice / create_invoice_from_registration.
concepts.use_instead: sis_billing_service.write_invoice(org_id, household_id=, student_user_id=, lines=[{description, amount_cents, class_id?, kind?}], discount_cents=, status=, due_date=, registration_id=, invoice_id=) -- or one of its three public callers when the shape matches. The count of 1 is the writer itself (exempt: []).

concepts.means: A Stripe Checkout Session being opened. Seven sites each built their own (an invoice, the emailed pay link, the whole family, autopay setup, household card setup, the funnel's fee or monthly plan, the funnel's staff preview); sis_billing_service.start_checkout is the one factory (M6, 2026-09-17) and every session's metadata carries kind, organization_id and ref_id beside the kind's own keys.
concepts.use_instead: sis_billing_service.start_checkout(secret, kind=, org_id=, ref_id=, success_url=, cancel_url=, mode=, line_items=, metadata=, idempotency_key=, **session_kwargs); kinds are CHECKOUT_KINDS. The count of 1 is the factory (exempt: []).

concepts.means: A Checkout Session being read back from Stripe to decide whether somebody paid (no webhooks: the platform verifies by reading). Seven readers each had their own loop and their own idea of paid; sis_billing_service.first_session(secret, session_ids, accept) is the one reader over retrieve_session / list_sessions (M6, 2026-09-17), with is_paid and is_complete_of_kind as the accept rules.
concepts.use_instead: sis_billing_service.first_session(secret, ids, billing.is_paid) (newest first; errors= to count unreadable sessions), retrieve_session for one known id, list_sessions for the funnel's by-email rescue. The count of 2 is retrieve_session + list_sessions inside the owner (exempt: []).

concepts.means: A signed, expiring link a family can pay from. Three namespaces (invoice, statement, card setup) share one signing helper in sis_pay_links; a fourth link kind must use it too.
concepts.use_instead: sis_pay_links._signed(namespace, payload). Do not construct an HMAC in an SIS route or service.

concepts.means: What the registration funnel charges a family, in cents. One backend engine (registration_pricing) and an older one in the funnel route disagreed about the fee, and four browser copies re-derived it for display; since M5 (2026-09-17) registration_pricing.quote() is the one number and the browser draws the lines it is given.
concepts.use_instead: registration_pricing.quote(cfg, kids, ...) on the backend; on the web, hooks/api/useRegistrationQuote (POST /api/registration/quote by invitation code, /registrations/<id>/quote for a family's own, /quote-preview for the setup tab's draft) and <QuoteLines quote={...} /> from components/registration/MonthlyPlan. The browser does no cents arithmetic.

concepts.means: A student's tuition for the year from their schedule: block tiers, the UFA flat plan and its 4th-day charge, supplies, the payment plan. The parent's Schedule Builder priced the week in the browser while the office's invoice seeded per class, so an invoice once billed a number the family was never shown.
concepts.use_instead: sis_tuition_service.schedule_quote(classes, time_blocks=..., block_pricing=..., tuition_plan=...) is the arithmetic; the parent builder reads schedule.tuition_quote from /api/sis/parent/students/<id>/schedule (the staff preview posts its class_ids to /api/registration/schedule-preview/<code>/quote) and seed_line_items() records the same lines on the invoice.

concepts.means: Cents rendered as dollars. Ten web copies and five backend copies disagreed on null ('--' vs '$0.00' vs '$0' vs ''), negatives and thousands; utils/money.js formatCents / formatDollars and backend utils/money.py format_cents are the rule (M7, 2026-09-17): '$1,500.00', a real minus for a refund, a dash for nothing on file, compact whole dollars for a plan price.
concepts.use_instead: web: formatCents(cents, { blank, compact }) or formatDollars(dollars, ...) from utils/money.js (import as `money` if the page reads better); backend: utils.money.format_cents(cents, blank=, compact=). One null rule, one negative rule, everywhere.

concepts.means: A family put on hold (households.registration_hold, or the pre-household directive that becomes it). Seven files wrote the flag, each with its own idea of when it clears; services/sis_holds.py is the one writer and the one payload (M2, 2026-09-17), and a directive is applied to the household exactly once at attach.
concepts.use_instead: sis_holds.set_hold(household_id, code, reason) / clear_hold_if(household, code) / clear_hold_for_guardian(org, guardian, code); hold_fields(held, code, reason) when a write carries other columns; hold_payload(household) to serialise; stage_directive(org, email, ...) and apply_directives(household_id, directive) for the pre-household staging; family_gate(org, student) for the class-signup check.

concepts.means: The unpaid-fee hold used to be recognised by comparing the hold's free-text reason to the sentence FEE_HOLD_REASON, so editing that text on the Families page made the hold un-clearable. households.registration_hold_code names the kind now (M2, 2026-09-17).
concepts.use_instead: sis_holds.is_held_for(household, sis_holds.UNPAID_FEE) / clear_hold_if(household, UNPAID_FEE). The reason is what the family reads; never compare it.

concepts.means: An API-wide gate that blocks a held adult until they do something (sign paperwork, verify a phone). Until M3 two middlewares carried the same allow-list, the same cache, and had the same masquerade bug fixed twice.
concepts.use_instead: Add a Hold to HOLDS in middleware/api_hold_gate.py: its code, its message, its is_blocked(user_id) from a utils/<thing>_hold.py, and the prefixes its own flow needs. The gate merges the allow-list and asks every hold in order. Never a second before_request.

concepts.means: A student's emergency contact rows. The funnel, the SIS student endpoint, the household endpoints and copy-from-family each wrote them, and a family re-submitting its details deleted what the office had added; services/emergency_contacts_service.py is the one writer (M4, 2026-09-17) and rows carry a `source`, so the funnel replaces only its own.
concepts.use_instead: emergency_contacts_service.replace_for_students(org, student_ids, contacts) for a family's own submission; add_emergency_contact / delete_emergency_contact / add_household_emergency_contact / remove_household_emergency_contacts / copy_family_contacts_to_student for the office; delete_for_students when the students themselves go. registrations.emergency_contacts is the funnel's draft only.

concepts.means: households.funding_source and its two mirrors (ufa_private, enrolled_private_school). Three write paths each spelled the mirror by hand; sis_payment_profile.funding_fields / set_funding_source is the one (M4, 2026-09-17), and ufa_private is not accepted on its own any more.
concepts.use_instead: sis_payment_profile.funding_fields(source) to merge into a household write, or set_funding_source(household_id, source, extra=) to write it; derive_funding_source(answers) for the family's own answer.

concepts.means: A school announcement, delivered once. sis_announcements is the post; announcements is the send (receipts, notification, email), linked by source_announcement_id. Until M1 each client decided which archive rows were the post's receipt -- the web by the link, the phone by matching title and day, so an edited post showed twice on the phone.
concepts.use_instead: sis_community_service.post() is the only caller of announcement_service.publish. The archive (GET /api/announcements/archive) marks a send `on_board` while its source post is on the board; a client renders what is not marked and never compares titles or days. The four sends that predated the link were linked in the data (20260918170000).

concepts.means: Who a message is for. Announcements said students/parents/advisors, the community board school/families/teachers, events school/teachers/admins, the archive had its own tuple. services/sis_audiences.py is the one vocabulary since M1; the calendar adopted it in M12.
concepts.use_instead: services/sis_audiences.py: BOARD_AUDIENCES, RECIPIENT_ROLES, EVENT_AUDIENCES, recipient_roles_for(board_audience), board_audience(value), normalize_recipient_roles(...). Import the words; never spell a vocabulary in a route or service.

concepts.means: The account a school speaks as. Four callers resolved organizations.inbox_user_id themselves before sending until M1.
concepts.use_instead: school_inbox_service.send_as_school(org, recipient_id, content, sent_by=..., fallback_sender=...) to send as the school; school_inbox_service.school_account(org) -> (org, inbox_user_id) where a route needs the id for a read. Never call get_or_create_inbox_user outside the service.

concepts.means: A hand-written role tuple on an SIS route. The tiers live in utils/sis_roles.py so a role added to one is added everywhere; community.py's three were the last until M1 (MEMBER_ROLES and ADULT_ROLES now exist for them).
concepts.use_instead: @require_role(*ADMIN_ROLES) or another tuple from utils/sis_roles.py. If no tier fits, add one there with a docstring.

concepts.means: Resolving the caller's organisation in an SIS route. Twenty-seven private copies of _org_or_error in three variants until M15; only three carried the request.form fix, so superadmin uploads failed on the other twenty-four.
concepts.use_instead: sis_service.org_or_error(user_id) for a staff route (org_id, err); sis_service.requested_org_id() where the route only needs the org the client named (the parent portal). One reader of the request, one resolver; never a private copy. The plan proposed utils/org_resolve.py, but utils may not import services (test_import_layers) and twenty-six tests patch services.sis_service.resolve_org_id, so the helper lives beside the resolver.

concepts.means: An /api/sis/internal/* endpoint the Render cron calls. Seven identical shapes across five route modules until M15: secret check, a users read for the superadmin fallback, call the service, log the count.
concepts.use_instead: Add a row to CRON_SWEEPS in routes/sis/internal.py: name -> a function returning the summary dict. The blueprint declares the route, checks the secret or the superadmin, and logs. jobs/cron_dispatch.py names the same paths.

concepts.means: Reading sis_events. Ten reads with four different audience filters until M12: the SIS calendar, the parent feed, the community feed, the ICS export, the dashboard, RSVPs.
concepts.use_instead: sis_events_service.list_events(org_id, viewer, from_iso=..., to_iso=..., limit=..., columns=...) with viewer 'admin' | 'staff' | 'family' | 'shared' (viewer_for_user(user_id) picks it from the roles); get_event / create_event / update_event / delete_event for the rest. The audience rule lives there and nowhere else.

concepts.means: What is happening at the school today. sis_coordinator_service.today_schedule(org_id, date, dow=..., class_scope=...) assembles it for both dashboards; the admin dashboard's second source was sis_service.get_dashboard, which is the census and is named so since M12.
concepts.use_instead: sis_coordinator_service.today_schedule(org_id, today, dow=..., class_scope=...). The school's headline counts are sis_service.census(org_id); there is no second dashboard assembler.

concepts.means: A school event's start_at is a wall clock wearing a UTC label (the office typed 18:30; Postgres stored 18:30+00). Every renderer must read it in UTC; until M12 six web sites each spelled that rule themselves, and the SIS admin's own Community page did not.
concepts.use_instead: fmtEventWhen(event), fmtEventDay(event), fmtEventTimeRange(event), splitEventStamp(iso) and fmtDayHeading(ymd) from utils/timeFormat.js (EVENT_STAMPS_ARE_WALL_CLOCK). schoolEventWallClock.test.js refuses a reader that formats the stamps anywhere else.

concepts.means: The school's time blocks, a JSON list inside feature_flags.sis_settings with no ids. Eight readers outside the catalog service; renaming a block orphans block rosters, the parent builder, the sheet sync and the AI editor at once.
concepts.use_instead: sis_catalog_service.schedule_settings(org_id)['time_blocks'] today; a sis_time_blocks table with stable ids behind the same function after M8b.

concepts.means: A school setting. Thirteen components each read the whole feature_flags blob, spread it, changed one key and PUT the whole thing back until M8a -- last write wins, and two cards open in two tabs erased each other.
concepts.use_instead: patchSisSettings(orgId, { sis_settings: { key: value } }) from hooks/api/useSisSettings.js; PATCH /api/sis/settings merges the keys you name onto the stored blob (services/org_settings_service.merge_patch) and runs the one guard set. Never build a feature_flags body in the browser, and never send a key you did not change. The organization row's own columns (name, branding, AI entitlements, quest policy) still go through the admin console's PUT.

concepts.means: The registration funnel's config, stored under feature_flags.registration. Until M8a the web mirrored every save to the legacy icreate_registration key; the server (utils/registration_config.with_registration_config) keeps a row's legacy key in step, and the one web read of it is the fallback the setup tab makes.
concepts.use_instead: Write feature_flags.registration only, through patchSisSettings(orgId, { registration: {...} }). Reading `flags.registration || flags.icreate_registration` is fine until the legacy keys are scrubbed.

concepts.means: An SIS page fetching the whole organisation record to read its config. Two pages copy-pasted the fetch until M8a.
concepts.use_instead: const { data, organization, loading, reload } = useOrgSettings(orgId) from hooks/api/useSisSettings.js.

concepts.means: Minutes-since-midnight, 12-hour time labels, 'does this class fit this age', 'how old is this child'. Twenty-five private copies lived across the parent builder, the CLP, the SIS calendar, the class pages and the embeds, and the builder and the CLP computed a child's age against different dates; utils/schedule.js is the one module (M11, 2026-09-17).
concepts.use_instead: toMin, overlaps, conflictsWith, fitsAge, ageFromDob(dob, asOf), fmtTime, DAY_LABELS and weekGrid from utils/schedule.js. A child's age is judged as of the org's first_day_of_school on every surface (web: pass asOf; backend: services/sis_age).

concepts.means: A week laid out as rows of class meetings keyed on start time. utils/schedule.weekGrid is the one model; WeeklyScheduleGrid, the CLP grid, the teacher's My Classes week and the public schedule embed draw it. Three hand-rolled copies carried the same 2026-08-25 bug comment and the continuation-row fix (32b2beb3) had reached only one.

web.pattern: slotSet = new Set\(|daySet = new Set\(|\(byDay\[\w+\] = byDay\[\w+\] \|\| \[\]\)

concepts.use_instead: weekGrid(classes, { recurringOnly }) from utils/schedule for the rows (days, slots, cell, endsBySlot, covering, unscheduled); <WeeklyScheduleGrid classes={...} /> when the student modal's blocks are what you want. Fix a row bug in the model, once.

concepts.means: One line describing a class to a family: seats, ages, price, times. Six files said 'Full -- waitlist', 'Class full', 'Full · Waitlist: 3', 'N seats left' and 'N spots left' for the same state; components/sis/ClassSummaryLine.jsx holds the words (M11, 2026-09-17).
concepts.use_instead: <ClassSummaryLine cls={c} meetings={...} price={...} /> for the line; seatState(cls), seatText(cls, { short }), ageBandText(cls) and <SeatPill cls /> from the same module when a screen needs one segment.

concepts.means: How old a student is for the school year: whole years as of the org's first day of school, the date the enrollment gates and the parent's builder already used. Ten SIS modules kept their own year-subtraction and counted from today, so a child was 9 on the roster and 10 on the CLP.
concepts.use_instead: sis_age.school_age(org_id, dob) for one student, sis_age.ages_for(org_id) for a roster (one settings read). sis_eligibility.age_on(dob) when the question really is about today (an adult signing, a child old enough for her own login). The copies left are platform account policy and two 120-year sanity checks; fold them onto age_on when those files are next open.

concepts.means: A status word mapped to a pill colour. Fourteen private maps in fourteen files until M10 (STATUS_STYLES x5, ATT_COLORS twice verbatim, ITEM_BADGE copied and drifted by one token).
concepts.use_instead: <StatusPill domain="attendance" status={s} /> from components/sis/ui/StatusPill; the vocabularies are data in components/sis/ui/statusMaps.js, one domain per queue, with statusLabel() and statusTone() for the rare non-pill use. A new status is a row in the map, not a new map.

concepts.means: Dashboard tiles deep-linked to tab names the Task Center no longer had, and the page remapped them on arrival. Retired by M10: the tiles name the live tabs and no sent notification uses an old name.
concepts.use_instead: Link to the canonical tab id (M10). A tile that links to a tab the page does not have is a bug in the tile.

concepts.means: The staff-forms admin queue rendered by two routes (/tasks and /forms) until M10; /forms now sends an admin to the Task Center with the deep link intact.
concepts.use_instead: AdminQueue mounts once, in TaskCenterPage; /forms redirects there (M10).

concepts.means: The tile on a dashboard. The admin, coordinator and teacher dashboards each defined their own Card until M10.
concepts.use_instead: <DashboardCard title action className> from components/sis/DashboardCard.jsx.

concepts.means: The org picker (a superadmin's school switcher), mounted by twenty-eight SIS pages in their own title rows until M14a; SisLayout mounts it once in the header.
concepts.use_instead: Nothing: SisLayout renders <SisOrgPicker> in the console header on every page. A page reads orgId from useSisOrg() and never mounts the picker.

concepts.means: A row of tabs on an SIS page. Fourteen files hand-rolled the underline recipe (plus the inbox's pill bar and the prior-learning chips) while GlassTabBar served fifteen non-SIS pages; every SIS tab bar is GlassTabBar now (M14b, 2026-09-17), and the pattern also catches the hand-rolled spinner, which is components/ui/Spinner.
concepts.use_instead: <GlassTabBar align="start" tabs={[{ id, label, badge? }]} active={...} onSelect={...} /> from components/ui (size="md" for a page's section bar, the default for a modal's). Tabs are role=tab: tests query getByRole('tab', { name }). Loading: <Spinner /> or <PageLoader /> from components/ui/Spinner.

concepts.means: The Tailwind string for a text input, spelled as a local constant in four incompatible recipes across thirty-seven SIS files. components/ui/Input.jsx and FormField.jsx are used by no SIS file.
concepts.use_instead: <Input> / <FormField> from components/ui. A page that needs a variant adds it there, once.

concepts.means: A dialog's backdrop and frame. Six SIS files hand-roll a fixed inset-0 overlay; billingPage has a private Modal beside components/ui/Modal.jsx.
concepts.use_instead: <Modal> from components/ui (or <ModalOverlay> for a bare backdrop). The portal guard in tests/modalPortalGuard.test.js counts the same recipe app-wide.

concepts.means: A sortable column header. Six copies of SortHeader with five different sort-state models over twenty-three raw tables.
concepts.use_instead: <SortableTable columns={...} rows={...} /> (M14e), one sort model, one header.

concepts.means: Picking a person from the school by typing. SearchSelect does this; three components rebuild it as a filtered list with a query box.
concepts.use_instead: <SearchSelect options={people} .../> from components/ui, the platform rule for any long-list picker.

concepts.means: The brand gradient spelled by hand (bg-gradient-to-r from-optio-purple ...) ninety-six times in SIS files, the spelling the design system forbids.
concepts.use_instead: <Button variant="primary"> or the .btn-primary class; see docs/design/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md.

concepts.means: A UI choice remembered per browser: export columns, cards or table, a sort. Seven SIS pages hand-wrote the try/JSON.parse/JSON.stringify against localStorage until M17, each with its own key and its own idea of a stale value.
concepts.use_instead: const [value, setValue] = usePersistedChoice('sis_<what>', initial, { validate }) from hooks/usePersistedChoice.js. sisOrgStore.js is exempt: it is a store read outside React (which org is in view), not a page's UI choice.

concepts.means: Printing from an SIS page. Five window.print() sites and four private @media print blocks until M17; the substitute sheet referenced a print class no stylesheet defined and printed the whole app behind the modal.
concepts.use_instead: printElement(target) from utils/printView.js for a part of the page (mark chrome no-print), printHtml(title, body) for a sheet built from scratch. The one @media print block is in index.css.

concepts.means: A CSV download of SIS rows. Five routes each built the response by hand until M17; one said in a comment that it copied another.
concepts.use_instead: csv_response(filename, header, rows) from utils/csv_response.py; the route's job is the rows.

concepts.means: Staff training. Two APIs, two stores, two targeting models and two progress reports: staff_training.py (quests, since July) and training_links.py (org_resources.is_training, since 2026-09-15). Six open tickets on /training are the symptom.
concepts.use_instead: One training catalogue row {kind: 'quest'|'link', targeting, required, progress} served by staff_training.py (M18); a link is a training whose completion is an ack. Web: one TrainingForm with a kind switch.

concepts.means: The parent portal and the teacher portal serve the same onboarding, forms and documents views from two route files with the bodies copied (eleven service calls), differing by bucket and gate.
concepts.use_instead: portal_views.<view>(org_id, user_id, bucket=..., allow_hr=...) (M9), mounted by parent.py and staff_portal.py as one-line routes; the route owners do not change.

concepts.means: Typing your name as a signature. Three UIs, two hard-coded affirmation sentences and one fetched from the server.

web.pattern: (By typing your name|typing my own name)

concepts.use_instead: <SignatureCapture statement={fromServer} onSign={...} /> (M9) for the funnel step, the checklist and HR; the affirmation text comes from the server.

concepts.means: Signature requests reachable at two paths (staff-admin and secure-documents) that mount the same view functions with a different allow_hr.
concepts.use_instead: /api/sis/secure-documents/signature-requests is the one mount (M9); the staff-admin path redirects for one release, then goes.

concepts.means: A staff member's phone number being edited. Four screens edited it (the teacher form, the employment profile, the teacher dashboard's prompt, My Profile); since M13c (2026-09-17) it is the staff record for anybody else and My Profile for yourself, and the dashboard's prompt is a door to My Profile.
concepts.use_instead: MyProfilePage edits your own phone; StaffDetailModal edits anyone else's (M13c). StudentDetailModal and FamilyDetailModal are exempt because a student's or guardian's phone is a different concept (M13a, M13b).

concepts.means: Where the class form is mounted. CreateClassModal used to be mounted twice, once as the create dialog and once EMBEDDED inside the class record's Details tab; since M13d (2026-09-17) components/sis/ClassForm.jsx is the one form, the create dialog wraps it and the record renders it in place. The count of 1 is the create dialog's mount on ClassesPage.
concepts.use_instead: ClassFieldsEditor is the one form; CreateClassModal mounts once from ClassesPage and the detail modal edits in place (M13d). Baseline after M13d: 1.

concepts.means: Putting a person in a family (household_members). Four app paths and three scripts insert the row; each re-implements 'is this the same student'.
concepts.use_instead: sis_attach_service.attach_student(org_id, student, household, source) (M16) is the one write path; M2's apply_directives runs inside it.

concepts.means: 'Is this the same person as that one.' likely_same_student in sis_service, _match_existing_dependent in registration_accounts_service, and two inline versions in the backfill and import scripts.
concepts.use_instead: person_matching.likely_same_student(a, b) (M16), one matcher with one definition of 'same', imported by every attach path.

concepts.means: The parent absence endpoint accepts three request shapes (student_user_id, student_user_ids, selections); web sends the newest, mobile the oldest.
concepts.use_instead: selections: [{student_user_id, class_ids}] is the one shape (M19), once the mobile OTA that sends it has shipped.

concepts.means: Two <Route path> rules for one path in App.jsx; the second is unreachable. The one there was (/connections, a stale redirect beside the live page) went with M19 on 2026-09-17.
concepts.use_instead: One rule per path. A redirect for a retired path replaces the old rule; it does not sit beside it.

concepts.means: Turning rows into a file the browser saves. Five SIS exports each quoted cells, joined lines and built a blob and an anchor by hand until M17; two used CRLF, one LF, and the byte-order mark Excel needs was easy to forget.
concepts.use_instead: toCsv(header, rows) and downloadCsv(text, filename) from utils/csv.js (downloadBlob for a file the server built). One quoting rule, CRLF, BOM.

concepts.means: The checkbox list behind a 'which columns' choice. Four pickers were hand-rolled with the same checkbox and different layouts until M17.
concepts.use_instead: <ColumnPicker columns selected onToggle groups? onSetGroup? /> from components/sis/ColumnPicker.jsx; the caller owns the selection (usePersistedChoice).

concepts.means: An in-app notification from the school's office (a seat offered, a payment due, a document to sign). Sent as type 'announcement' until M1, so a family could not mute announcements without muting these; 'school_notice' since 2026-09-17.
concepts.use_instead: sis_notifications.notify(user_id, title, message, link=..., organization_id=..., service=...) -- it carries the type. 'announcement' is for announcement_service.publish and nothing else.
